The grand Raja Gopuram was constructed over a century ago by the Gollapalli Kesarla Ramaiah Setty family, whose descendants still care for the temple; hereditary archakas (the Rajagopala Bhattar family) are said to have served for 13 generations. name: Venkataramana Temple
town_description: Ronur (also written Ronuru) is a village and hobli in Srinivasapura taluk of Kolar district, Karnataka, in the state's mango-growing belt. It is known for the ancient Sri Lakshmi Venkataramana Swamy Temple and for its mangoes, and is the native place of former Chief Justice of India S. Rajendran. The village lies in eastern Karnataka's semi-arid plains, roughly 15 km from Srinivasapura town.

travel.road: Reached by road from Srinivasapura (Srinivasapura taluk) and from Kolar town (~30 km, verify) via local buses and taxis

visitor_information.best_time: Chaitra month (March-April) for the Brahmotsava; otherwise October to March
